Nice refactor — the modal got noticeably tighter and the new hook + docstring make the data pipeline easy to follow. A few things worth tightening:

#### Bugs / correctness

**1. Search analytics fires once per "from-empty" session, not "per non-empty query"** — `apps/web/src/components/common/SpaceSafeBar/AccountsModal/useAccountsModalItems.ts:117-130`
The comment says *"Fire SEARCH analytics once per non-empty query (debounced)"*, but `searchTracked` only resets when search becomes empty. Typing `a` → `ab` → `abc` fires the event once total (for `a`), not three times. If that's intentional, the comment is misleading; if not, `searchTracked.current = false` should also reset inside the timer-clear path so each *distinct* query gets one event. [Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=In%20apps%2Fweb%2Fsrc%2Fcomponents%2Fcommon%2FSpaceSafeBar%2FAccountsModal%2FuseAccountsModalItems.ts%20on%20branch%20tongyao%2Fwa-2462-add-all-accounts-button-for-the-safe-selector-on-the-spaces%2C%20clarify%20the%20intent%20of%20the%20%60searchTracked%60%20ref%20at%20lines%20117-130.%20The%20comment%20says%20%22once%20per%20non-empty%20query%22%20but%20the%20code%20only%20fires%20once%20per%20%22from-empty%22%20session.%20Either%20fix%20the%20code%20to%20track%20distinct%20queries%20or%20update%20the%20comment%20to%20match%20actual%20behavior.&repo=safe-global/safe-wallet-monorepo)

**2. `filteredAllSafes` early-return drops the filter when `spaceExclusionKey` is empty but the user *is* in a space** — `useAccountsModalItems.ts:89-92`
```ts
if (!allSafes || !spaceExclusionKey) return allSafes
```
`spaceExclusionKey` is `null` only when `isQualifiedSafe === false`, so this is functionally fine today. But if a future change made `spaceExclusionKey` an empty `Set` instead of `null` (e.g. space loaded with zero safes), the truthiness check would still work — but the intent is clearer as `if (!allSafes || !isQualifiedSafe) return allSafes`. Minor readability nit.

**3. `useAllSafesGrouped(filteredAllSafes ?? [])` creates a new array reference every render when loading** — `useAccountsModalItems.ts:94`
If `useAllSafesGrouped` uses referential equality for memoization, the `?? []` fallback defeats it during the loading window. Either memoize the fallback or rely on `filteredAllSafes` being stable.

#### Code quality

**4. Render duplication in `AccountsModal/index.tsx:77-133`** — the Trusted / Other sections are essentially the same JSX with different headings and source arrays. Extracting an inline `renderSection(title, items, testId?)` helper would shrink ~60 lines to ~25 and make future per-section divergence safer. Optional.

**5. Test couples to undocumented internals** — `useAccountsModalItems.test.ts:20-25` calls `actual._getMultiChainAccounts` and `actual._getSingleChainAccounts`. Those underscore-prefixed exports are essentially a private contract; renaming them later will produce cryptic test failures. Consider either documenting them as test-only exports or building the grouped result with a public helper.

**6. `ShortAddressWithTooltip` assumes `address.length ≥ 10`** — `shared.tsx:158-167`
The bolded-similar branch slices `address.slice(2, 6)` and `address.slice(-4)` without the same length guard as `TooltipFullAddress` (line 121). Today the consumers always pass a validated 0x-address, so this is theoretical, but it's inconsistent with the tooltip helper directly above it.

#### Test coverage

- The **multi-chain partial-workspace degrade** path (the headline edge case mentioned in the PR description / step 8) isn't directly asserted as a multi → single transformation in `useAccountsModalItems.test.ts`. Worth one targeted test: ADDR_A on chains 1 + 100, workspace excludes chain 1, expect the result to contain a *single-chain* item on chain 100 (not a `MultiChainSafeItem`).
- The **`open=false` no-op for the error notification** isn't asserted. Quick test: with `ownedSafesError` set but `open=false`, `dispatch` should not be called.

#### Nice things

- Filtering before grouping (so multi-chain auto-degrades) is the right call, well-explained in the docstring.
- `isLoading` gating on both `useAllSafes` + `useSpaceSafes` cleanly closes the flash-of-unfiltered-content bug.
- The "Trusted" semantics (pinned, not space-membership) limitation is called out in the hook docstring — good defensive documentation for the next reader.
- Backward-compat default values on `hidePinControls` / `isSimilar` keep the additive props clean.
